scene_1.texte: They were not heroes. They had no shared destiny, nor any prophecy to fulfill.

scene_2.texte: They were just four broken souls who had decided to survive together in a cruel world...

scene_3.texte: ...and it was in this simple survival that their story began.

scene_4.texte: In the beginning, all was chaos. Esh, the huntress, was an uncontrollable flame.

scene_5.texte: In the early days, she had drawn her bow not against an enemy, but against Kelerm, the brute who would become their leader.

scene_6.texte: Then, it was Lilith’s turn, the protector, to be the target of those unpredictable arrows. The group was trembling, on the verge of shattering.

scene_7.texte: That’s where Ash entered the picture. The Rogue, the one who knew how to listen, the one everyone adored—stepped up as the glue that held it all together.

scene_8.texte: He took the title of Lieutenant to protect. And to seal the peace, he did the impossible: he married Esh.

scene_9.texte: For a time, it worked. Esh’s arrows fell silent. Ash believed he had won the inner war.

scene_10.texte: To strengthen this newfound peace, the Company opened its ranks to a new mystical force: Kuro, the Black Doctor.

scene_11.texte: Kuro had been raised by wild boars. A wild upbringing that gave him an iron will... as long as he stayed awake.

scene_12.texte: But nature does not change so easily. Esh’s most devastating instinct has reawakened: that of a relentless sharpshooter.

scene_13.texte: In a move that seemed almost deliberate, she turned this new power on Lilith. Twice. Not by mistake. Not by accident.

scene_14.texte: The result was a cruel irony: Esh, the aggressor, grew even stronger. And Lilith, the victim, was marked by the seal of profound exhaustion.

scene_15.texte: And in the midst of it all, there was Kelerm. The leader. He was there, sitting apart, gazing at the fire. He said nothing. It was silence amidst the screaming.

scene_16.texte: Today, the band moves forward. They are not heroes. They are mercenaries. And their adventure is a daily struggle to stay together.
